methods: Review the complete identified page in the user-supplied 1889 St Alphonsus PDF, not merely an OCR matching token
Use supplied Fortescue as historical context; never treat it as exact 1962 ceremonial law
Crosscheck only existing GitHub certified Low/Missa Cantata/Solemn form registry and source-cue text; no new outside references
Distinguish differences in wording/voice from independent actor/voice clock and from valid historical exceptions
